name: BBOOK Appointment Scheduler
author: bbook.app

sections.description:
BBOOK is the easiest way to add an online booking system to your WordPress website. Connect your free bbook.app account and embed a professional booking calendar on any page or post — no coding required.

Perfect for barbers, hair salons, beauty salons, nail technicians, spas, massage therapists, tattoo studios, clinics, personal trainers, consultants, and any service-based business that takes appointments.

Why BBOOK?

  • Free to start — Create your account and start accepting online bookings in minutes
  • Built for local businesses — Designed specifically for service businesses that rely on appointments
  • Mobile-friendly — Your customers can book appointments from any device
  • No coding required — Just paste a shortcode and your booking page appears
  • Automatic reminders — Reduce no-shows with SMS and email appointment reminders
  • Accept payments — Let customers pay when they book online
  • Manage from anywhere — Use the BBOOK mobile app (iOS & Android) to manage your schedule on the go

Embed Options

Three ways to add appointment booking to your WordPress site:

  • [bbook_widget] — Full booking widget with service selection, staff picker, and calendar. Embed it on any page for a complete online booking experience.
  • [bbook_button] — A simple “Book Now” button that links to your online booking page. Add it to headers, sidebars, or anywhere on your site.
  • [bbook_full_page] — Full-page booking embed for a dedicated appointment scheduling page with no distractions.

What You Can Do with BBOOK

  • Let customers book appointments online 24/7
  • Set your availability and working hours
  • Manage multiple services and staff members
  • Send automated appointment reminders via SMS and email
  • Accept online payments through Stripe, Mollie, SumUp, and more
  • View and manage your booking calendar from web or mobile
  • Share your online booking link anywhere

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the following external services:

bbook.app

The plugin connects to bbook.app to authenticate your account and retrieve your business details during the connection flow. Data sent: your WordPress site URL. Data received: API key, business ID, business name, and booking page slug.

  • Service URL: https://app.bbook.app
  • Terms of Service: https://bbook.app/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://bbook.app/privacy

rsv.to (BBOOK Booking Pages)

The booking widget shortcodes embed an iframe from rsv.to, which hosts your public booking page. No data is sent from WordPress to this service — it simply displays your booking page to visitors.

  • Service URL: https://rsv.to
  • Terms of Service: https://bbook.app/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://bbook.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to BBOOK.APP in the admin sidebar.
  4. Click Connect to bbook.app and sign in or create a free account.
  5. Copy a shortcode and paste it into any page or post to start accepting bookings.
sections.faq:
Do I need a bbook.app account?

Yes, but it’s free to create one. Sign up at bbook.app and set up your services, availability, and booking page in minutes.

Is this plugin free?

Yes, the WordPress plugin is completely free. BBOOK offers a free plan to get started, with optional paid plans for advanced features like SMS reminders and online payments.

What types of businesses is BBOOK for?

BBOOK is designed for any service business that takes appointments: barber shops, hair salons, beauty salons, nail salons, spas, massage therapists, tattoo studios, dental clinics, physiotherapists, personal trainers, consultants, tutors, photographers, and more.

Can my customers book appointments online?

Yes! Once you embed the booking widget on your site, customers can browse your services, pick a time slot, and book an appointment — all without leaving your WordPress site.

Does BBOOK send appointment reminders?

Yes. BBOOK can send automated SMS and email reminders to reduce no-shows. Configure reminders from your bbook.app dashboard.

Can I accept online payments?

Yes. Connect your preferred payment provider — Stripe, Mollie, SumUp, and more — in bbook.app to accept payments when customers book appointments online.

Can I customize the booking widget?

The widget uses your bbook.app booking page settings, including your services, staff, availability, and branding. Customize everything from the bbook.app dashboard.

Does this plugin store customer data?

No. All booking and customer data is securely handled by bbook.app. The plugin only stores your connection credentials to display the booking widget.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. The booking widget is fully responsive and works with any WordPress theme, page builder, or block editor.

Can I manage bookings from my phone?

Yes. Download the BBOOK mobile app for iOS or Android to manage appointments, view your calendar, and communicate with customers on the go.
